prompt: I need help writing our quarterly all-hands update. We're a 800-person fintech company called NeoBank. The last 3 months have been crazy - we closed Series C funding ($120M led by Sequoia), launched our new credit card product, hit 500K active users, hired our new CTO Sarah Chen from Stripe, and had some regulatory delays with our EU expansion. There's also been confusion about our new hybrid work policy and questions about the upcoming performance review cycle. Can you help me create a comprehensive internal communication that covers all these major updates? Make it something our CEO would send to the whole company.
